title: Daemons of the Shadow Realm
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Yuru, a young hunter in an isolated mountain village, visits his twin sister Asa, who is kept in a cage to perform a secret village 'duty'. When modern gunmen attack the village, one of them looks exactly like Asa, and Yuru awakens two guardian Daemons, Left and Right. He leaves for the modern world to learn the truth about the two Asas and the twins' prophesied power.
life_message: Family bonds and the courage to question the stories one was raised on matter more than prophecy or power.
